2.why: The Kyoto Protocol set targets to cut greenhouse gas emissions in order to slow climate change: B and C both fit.
2.notice: Two options fit: the Kyoto Protocol limits greenhouse gas emissions, and it does so to fight climate change. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

8.why: The first woman to head a public sector bank was Ranjana Kumar (Indian Bank, 2000), not offered. Arundhati Bhattacharya was the first woman to head SBI.
8.notice: Strictly, the first woman to head a public sector bank was Ranjana Kumar (Indian Bank, 2000), who is not an option. Arundhati Bhattacharya, option (1), was the first woman to head the State Bank of India, the largest one. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

58.why: The midnight sun is seen near both poles, each in its own summer: A and B both right.
58.notice: Two options are correct: the midnight sun is seen in summer near the North Pole and near the South Pole. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

69.why: Digested food is absorbed in the small intestine, mostly in its jejunum and ileum; ileum is the usual school answer, jejunum is also right.
69.notice: Digested food is absorbed in the small intestine, both in the jejunum and in the ileum, so two options can be called right. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
